buildings.name: Halvermouth Hall of Justice
buildings.sign: HALL OF JUSTICE · OFFICE OF THE MAYOR

npcs.name: Lawrence Order
npcs.role: Chief of Police, Halvermouth Precinct 1. Careless, comfortable, and very much for sale.

npcs.name: Sergeant Justin Case
npcs.role: Sergeant. Over-prepared for everything, just in case. Walks the Civic Plaza and the East End.

npcs.name: Officer Warren Tee
npcs.role: Beat officer. By the book, obsessed with warrants. Walks the Sumps and the Docks.

npcs.name: Arthur Anderson
npcs.role: Leader of the Sums of Anarchy. Always angry. Runs the Sumps' calculator trade like a spreadsheet, and protects the Sumps like family.

npcs.name: Al Gebra
npcs.role: Arthur's right hand and enforcer. Solves for X. Delivers the gang's warnings in person.

npcs.name: Percy Ntage
npcs.role: The gang's bookkeeper. Takes a cut of everything. Keeps the grudge ledger up to date for Arthur.

npcs.name: Minnie Mus
npcs.role: Runs the counter at the Abacus. Sells the gang's calculators — to customers, and to you, if Arthur allows it.

npcs.name: Dee Nominator
npcs.role: The muscle. Bouncer at the Abacus door. "Everything comes down to the bottom line. I am the bottom line."

npcs.name: Tony Tangent
npcs.role: Lookout at the Sumps gate. Watches for cops. Never finishes a — oh, look, a pigeon.

npcs.name: Max Imum
npcs.role: The reckless one. Always pushes it to the limit. Wanders the fire barrels starting arguments.

npcs.name: Ray Doyle
npcs.role: Dockhand on the early shift. Runs on Overclocks.

npcs.name: Mo Kettering
npcs.role: Busker. Needs to be charming for tips. Swears by Rose-Gold Sums.

npcs.name: Dot Pruitt
npcs.role: Dropped out of the university. Thinks a Big Brain 9000 is the only way to keep up.

npcs.name: Bill Hobb
npcs.role: Bare-knuckle boxer past his prime. Takes a Brick before every fight.

npcs.name: Lena Szabo
npcs.role: Pickpocket. Featherkeys keep her fingers quick.

npcs.name: Gus Oakley
npcs.role: Old sailor with a bad leg. Plus Packs keep him walking.

npcs.name: Fern Abara
npcs.role: Volunteers at the Mission. Needs the charm to keep the donations coming.

npcs.name: Nico Varga
npcs.role: Works nights at Cold Storage. Lives on Overclocks and regret.

npcs.name: Hattie Crane
npcs.role: Runs card games behind the Mission. Big Brains help her count.

npcs.name: Bram Stokes
npcs.role: Scrap collector. Hauls metal all day on Bricks.

npcs.name: Pearl Quigley
npcs.role: Seamstress with failing eyes. Featherkeys steady her hands.

npcs.name: Sol Mendel
npcs.role: Former boxer's cornerman, now a wreck. Plus Packs for the hangovers.

npcs.name: Sal Vage
npcs.role: Runs Sal's Surplus Electronics at the docks. Sells calculator parts, machinery and delivery contracts. Asks no questions.

npcs.name: Julian Beaumont
npcs.role: Proprietor of the Beaumont Motor Gallery in Halvermouth's East End. Sells cars the way other people sell paintings: slowly, and only to the right sort of person.

npcs.name: Vera Lusk
npcs.role: Head cashier of the Phonograph Grand. Runs the cage: obols in, chips out, and the other way round, to the last chip.

npcs.name: Prudence Tally
npcs.role: Chief teller of the First Bank of Halvermouth. Runs the counter, knows every account holder by hand-writing, and corrects the Governor in pencil.

npcs.name: Cyrus Coupon
npcs.role: Bond clerk at the First Bank of Halvermouth. Sells government bonds at par, explains yields to anyone who stands still, and is thrilled by all of it.

npcs.name: Bertram Locke
npcs.role: Guard at the First Bank of Halvermouth. Stands by the vault door nine to five, as he has for nineteen years, and has never once looked behind it.
